positions.title: Application Programmer III
positions.description:
Development and maintenance of Electronic Document Interface related to processing insurance claims.
Utilized Agile software development practices, Clean code concepts and  writing unit tests for software objects.
Development tools: Visual Studio 2010 (C#) using WPF with MVVM pattern, Progress 4GL, ClearCase and Mercurial.

positions.description:

Utilized Agile software development practices, Clean code concepts and  writing unit tests for software objects.
Development tools: Visual Studio 2010 (C#) using WPF with MVVM pattern, Progress 4GL, ClearCase and Mercurial.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop a next generation of the company's current application.
Develop services as well as user interfaces including customized controls.
Develop business logic layer, required database objects, SQL stored procedures and table triggers.
Write documentation for classes and module interfaces.
Development tools: Visual Studio 2008 & 2010 (VB.NET), MS SQL and Crystal Reports.

positions.title: Production Mananger
positions.description:
Hardware and Software development and manufacturer of high precision GPS survey equipment.

•	Purchase electronic components; manage inventory and product Bill of Materials.
•	Manage production personnel and schedules.
•	Develop user applications as needed utilizing VC++, VB, Embedded C++ and Microsoft Access.
•	Develop internal applications for managing business processes.
•	Write and manage assembly instructions, product documentation and user manuals

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
•	Develop and maintain software for managing Community Service Fees, Roof Repair, Community Budgets, and other applications tracking application.  
•	Created a specialized application for the owners to manage investments, stocks and bonds, spread out over multiple companies and multiple investment firms.
•	Utilized Microsoft Access, Visual Basic .NET and MS SQL for the data repository.

company.name: On Top of the World Communities

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Serve as project engineer to define requirements and manage software development and implementation schedules.
•	Develop and maintain software for the commuter train industry that interfaces to on-train GPS equipment developed by the company. 
•	Utilized Visual Studio 6.0, Visual Basic, XML, COM, COM+, and Window NT/2000 Client/Server applications and MS SQL for the data repository.
•	Develop interfaces to Wireless Network providers to receive and send information to on-train equipment

positions.title: Software Development Engineer/Customer Service Manager
positions.description:
•	Oversee service personnel.
•	Point of contact for customers 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
•	Defined & developed software for the Television Broadcast Industry for playback of video from digitally encoded files, MPEG-2.  Using Visual C++ as the development tool for Window 95/NT applications.
•	Software development using Visual C++ and Visual FoxPro.
•	Wrote user manuals, installed equipment and software, and trained operations personnel.

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst
positions.description:
•	Served as contact point for IS department when the IS Director is unavailable.
•	Analysis, development, implementation, and maintenance of client/server application and RDBMS for customer service using Oracle 7 and Gupta SQLWindows 
•	Served as Database Administrator.
•	Maintained networked sales system and performed analysis for new Telemarketing system, which included interfacing with telephone switch equipment.
•	Maintained software used to ship service and warranty parts across the U.S. and abroad via multiple carriers and also included:
	interfaces that tie back to the Customer Service application
	electronic transfer of manifest to carrier
•	Evaluation and selection of software and hardware to meet business needs and maintain connectivity between multiple buildings and computing platforms such as a UNIX based CAD system, Novell servers, and an HP3000 running MPE.
•	Served as network administrator/manager of Novell-based LANs.
•	Hired and supervised summer interns.

educations.schoolName: University of Florida - Warrington College of Business
